knowledge_entries.title: General pre-employment health checks in Shanghai: no city-wide unified standard found; follow the institution designated by the employer's HR
knowledge_entries.summary: No city-wide unified standard or item list for general pre-employment health checks for ordinary workers has been found in Shanghai. Verification path: the institution, items, and who bears the cost for a general pre-employment health check all follow the institution/package designated by the employer's HR; where the employer designates none, use a legitimate medical institution recognized by HR. This entry is a research conclusion (no official unified standard document found), not a confirmation of any standard.
knowledge_entries.applicability: Domestic job seekers employed in Shanghai (including cross-city job movers)
exclusions: Civil servant recruitment health checks follow national unified standards such as the General Standard for Civil Servant Recruitment Health Checks (Trial); this entry does not apply;

Health checks for workers in specific industries such as food, medical care, and public places follow special regulations such as the Food Safety Law and the Regulations on the Administration of Sanitation in Public Places; this entry does not apply;

Foreign nationals working/studying/residing in China for more than 1 year must complete their health check at a customs-designated institution (Shanghai International Travel Healthcare Center); this entry does not apply.
knowledge_entries.effective_from: 2026-09-23 (research conclusion date; not the policy effective date)
steps: Before onboarding, confirm with the employer's HR: whether a checkup institution is designated, the designated package/item list, who bears the checkup cost, and how and by when the report should be submitted.

If the employer designates none, prioritize a Grade-A tertiary (top-tier) hospital health management center or a legitimate third-party checkup institution recognized by HR (subject to HR recognition).
Bring the original ID card, go on an empty stomach on the checkup day; book in advance as required by the institution.

knowledge_entries.title: Shanghai dog registration and licensing (dog license) guide
knowledge_entries.summary: Dogs kept in Shanghai must be registered and the owner must obtain a Dog Registration Certificate (dog license). Eligibility: the owner must have full civil capacity (18 years or older) and a fixed residence in the city; the dog must be at least 3 months old; the dog must first complete rabies immunization and microchip implantation at a designated immunization site, obtain an Immunization Certificate, and be confirmed not to be a prohibited breed (see ke_pet_002). Materials: personal identification, property ownership certificate or lease proof in the city, the dog's immunization certificate (sterilization surgery certificate if neutered). Channels: online via the WeChat mini-program SuiShenBan (Shanghai government services app) — search "文明养犬一件事" (Civilized Dog Ownership One-Stop Service) → "进入办事大厅" (Enter the service hall) and select the service; offline at the local police station of your residence or a district-level one-stop dog registration reception point (taking Hongkou District as an example: online applications are reviewed within 5 working days by the dog-management officer of the local police station; offline applications with complete materials are completed on the spot). Fees: CNY 500 per dog per year in core areas within the Inner Ring Road, CNY 300 per dog per year outside the Inner Ring Road, free in rural areas. Annual review: must be completed within 30 days before the dog license expires, submitting a valid immunization certificate and paying the annual management fee. Unregistered dogs or missed annual reviews are ordered by public security departments to rectify within a time limit; overdue non-rectification results in a personal fine of CNY 200–1,000, and dogs still unregistered after the deadline are taken into custody (Article 42 of the Shanghai Dog Management Regulations).
knowledge_entries.applicability: Dog owners (including newly settled / cross-city movers planning to live long-term in Shanghai with a dog)
knowledge_entries.exclusions: Breeds on the prohibited list may not be registered; one dog per household (one dog per household in urban areas; see ke_pet_003)
knowledge_entries.effective_from: Unknown (the Shanghai Dog Management Regulations took effect 2011-05-15; the one-dog-per-household policy was implemented the same day)

knowledge_entries.title: Shanghai civilized dog ownership daily rules: one dog per household, mandatory immunization, and outing restraints
knowledge_entries.summary: In urban areas, each household may keep at most one dog (one dog per household; "household" means one residential property). Owners must have their dogs rabies-immunized as legally required: once a dog reaches 3 months old, take it to a veterinary-authority-designated site for vaccination and electronic identification implantation. When taking a dog out, follow: leash the dog (leash no longer than 2 meters, tightened in crowded places), muzzle large dogs, and immediately clean up the dog's feces. If a dog's barking disturbs others' normal life, the owner must stop it; violators are warned by public security, and those who do not rectify after warning face a fine of CNY 200–500. Taking a dog out without a leash: public security orders rectification and may impose a fine of CNY 20–200; failing to clean up feces: urban management enforcement orders rectification, and refusal to rectify results in a fine of CNY 20–200. If a dog injures a person, the owner must immediately take the injured person to a medical facility and pay medical expenses in advance. When a dog dies, it must be sent to a designated harmless-treatment site per animal epidemic prevention rules; self-burial or dumping is not allowed.
knowledge_entries.applicability: Dog owners (daily keeping conduct rules)
knowledge_entries.exclusions: The rural-area limit wording follows the original Regulations and local enforcement (original Regulations not verified this round)

knowledge_entries.title: Cross-city move with a dog/cat to Shanghai: Animal Quarantine Certificate and accompanying materials
knowledge_entries.summary: Bringing a dog or cat from another city into Shanghai (and traveling by plane/train/ship) requires an Animal Quarantine Certificate valid for only 5 days (issued by an official animal health supervision institution; time the application close to travel). Materials for a dog coming to Shanghai from another city: the owner's ID and proof of temporary residence in Shanghai, a valid rabies vaccination certificate from an official immunization site in the original city, a valid rabies antibody test report, and the Animal Quarantine Certificate issued at the place of origin (must be obtained before entering Shanghai). For a cat coming to Shanghai: the owner's ID and proof of temporary residence in Shanghai, a valid rabies vaccination certificate from an official immunization site (vaccinated at least 21 days before), and the Animal Quarantine Certificate issued at the place of origin. Note: dogs must also hold a valid dog registration certificate issued by public security (locally registered dogs); rabies antibody testing takes about 10–14 days and must be planned ahead; Shanghai currently has 4 officially recognized rabies antibody testing labs.
knowledge_entries.applicability: Users moving cross-city with a pet (dog/cat) to Shanghai; also applies to local dog owners traveling out of Shanghai with their dog
knowledge_entries.exclusions: International entry (bringing pets into China from abroad) follows a separate customs quarantine process not covered by this entry

knowledge_entries.title: Flying with pets in/out of Shanghai: checked vs. in-cabin options and document requirements
knowledge_entries.summary: Multiple airlines offer pet transport: oxygenated cargo-hold checked transport (Air China, China Southern, China Eastern, Hainan Airlines, Shandong Airlines, Sichuan Airlines, etc.); some airlines offer in-cabin pet service (Hainan, China Southern, China Eastern, Juneyao, Shenzhen Airlines, etc.), with pets kept in a compliant carrier under the seat (China Eastern/Shandong/Hainan require carriers no larger than 35×28×24 cm; Juneyao allows up to 58×37×35 cm for pets under 10 kg). Documents: airlines generally require proof of rabies vaccination and an Animal Health Certificate issued by an official veterinarian/animal quarantine institution, and may require signing a pet transport application. Fees: mostly weight-based at 1.5% of the economy-class ticket price per kg (pet + carrier combined); China Southern and others use fixed rates by route and weight; confirm with the airline at booking time — book early (limited capacity). Note: China Eastern may refuse cargo transport when transit temperatures are below -12℃ or above 30℃; Air China allows 1 pet per passenger and does not accept pregnant or newborn pets. Airline rules vary widely — always confirm with the specific airline before travel.

knowledge_entries.exclusions: Snub-nosed dogs, aggressive breeds, and other breeds some airlines refuse are subject to each airline's official rules (airline official sites not individually verified this round)

knowledge_entries.title: High-speed rail pet consignment pilot: 12306 "pet"-marked trains and key procedures
knowledge_entries.summary: The railway pet consignment service for high-speed rail is in an expanding pilot phase: as of the fourth pilot expansion on January 28, 2026, 110 stations and 170 high-speed trains support it, with Shanghai-related stations included (check specific routes/trains in the 12306 client). How to book: passengers holding tickets marked with the "宠" (pet) symbol can book online via the 12306 client's "宠物托运" (Pet Consignment) function (before 12:00 daily, earliest bookable for the next day; at/after 12:00, earliest for the third day), max 2 healthy pets per person; non-ticketed passengers must book 2–5 days in advance via the "中铁快运" (China Railway Express) WeChat mini-program, max 1 pet. The consignor must, at least 2 hours before departure, bring the pet, their ID, and a valid Animal Quarantine Certificate to the China Railway Express business office at the high-speed rail station to complete procedures. Freight is priced by mileage tiers; China Railway Express notifies pickup by SMS or phone within 1 hour after the pet arrives. Details: 12306 or China Railway Express 95572. The pilot scope and rules may keep changing — check the 12306 client in real time before travel.

knowledge_entries.exclusions: Pet consignment on conventional trains (non-high-speed) and aggressive breeds designated by the state are not covered (per third-party reports: single-pet weight/shoulder-height limits were not verified against official rules this round)

knowledge_entries.title: Shanghai four-category waste sorting standard (recyclable / hazardous / wet / dry waste)
knowledge_entries.summary: Since 2019-07-01, Shanghai has legally implemented four-category household waste sorting: recyclable waste (waste paper / waste plastics / waste glass / waste metals / waste textiles, etc.), hazardous waste (waste batteries / waste fluorescent tubes / waste medicines / waste paint and their containers, etc.), wet waste (i.e., perishable waste: food scraps / leftovers / expired food / fruit peels and cores / flowers and plants / traditional Chinese medicine dregs, etc.), and dry waste (all other household waste). Individuals mixing waste face fines up to CNY 200; organizations mixing and transporting face fines up to CNY 50,000.
knowledge_entries.applicability: All residents in Shanghai who must fulfill waste sorting and disposal obligations
exclusions: Bulky waste (sofas, mattresses, etc.) requires scheduled pickup or delivery to designated points; construction waste must be bagged and taken to designated disposal points; large appliances can be scheduled with legitimate e-waste recyclers

Wet waste: food, leftover, expired food, fruit and vegetable waste, flowers and plants. Dry waste: other household waste excluding recyclable, hazardous and wet waste. knowledge_entries.title: Shanghai waste disposal requirements and common tricky categories
knowledge_entries.summary: Official disposal requirements: wet waste drained and packaging removed, recyclables clean/dry/flattened, hazardous waste handled gently with fragile items wrapped, dry waste drained as much as possible; when unsure of the category, dispose as dry waste. Tricky-category mnemonics: recyclables look for "glass, metal, plastic, paper, clothing"; hazardous look for "medicine, oil, batteries"; wet waste look for "perishable and fragile"; everything else is dry waste.
knowledge_entries.applicability: All residents in Shanghai who must fulfill waste sorting and disposal obligations
steps: Wet waste: drain water as much as possible before disposal; remove packaging first for packaged items (packaging sorted separately by material); pure liquids (e.g., milk) go straight down the sink
Recyclables: keep clean and dry; empty three-dimensional packaging, rinse and flatten before disposal; wrap fragile or sharp-edged items first

Hazardous waste: handle gently; dispose of fragile items and expired medicines together with their packaging or wrapped separately; empty pressure containers first; seal volatile items before disposal
Dry waste: drain as much as possible; when unsure of the category, dispose as dry waste

Tricky items: crayfish shells = wet waste; coconut shells / durian shells / walnut shells / corn husks / sugarcane peels = dry waste; most cosmetics = dry waste; nail polish / nail polish remover = hazardous waste; unfinished milk tea / yogurt in three steps: pour out the liquid → pearls/fruit residues = wet waste → cup and straw = dry waste

evidence.excerpt: Recyclable: keep it clean and dry... empty the contents of all packaging, clean it and then press it flat. Hazardous: handle with care; easily breakable items and expired medicines should be disposed of together with their packaging or wrapped separately. Wet waste: drain off the water before disposal; remove packaging before disposal. Dry waste: dispose in dry waste collection containers... Remove as much water as possible. If it's difficult to determine the category, dispose of it as general garbage.
evidence.source_name: Shanghai Landscaping and City Appearance Administrative Bureau: A guide to waste classification

evidence.excerpt: Both small and large crayfish shells are wet garbage. Unfinished milk tea or yogurt: Step 1 pour into the sink; Step 2 residues as wet garbage; Step 3 cup and straw as dry garbage.

knowledge_entries.summary: Per the "Paying Rent" chapter of the Shanghai Housing Provident Fund website's Business Guide (search engine's scraped text of the official PDF; the PDF could not be opened directly for re-verification this round), the quotas and handling rules under the online-signing & filing model are: each household (applicant and spouse) may withdraw monthly no more than the actual rent expense of that month, and no more than the stored balance of the applicant's housing provident fund account (at least CNY 0.01 must be retained); a single withdrawal may not exceed three months' withdrawal quota. Monthly withdrawal cap: raised from CNY 3,000 to CNY 4,000 effective 2024-11-01 (guide section V "Notes" (2) original: "Each household (including single-person households) may withdraw monthly no more than the actual rent expense. Time requirements: applications should be made within the lease term, and the applied withdrawal period shall be within the rental registration filing period. Service methods: ① entrusted monthly withdrawal — entrust the municipal provident fund center to automatically transfer the account balance to the applicant's bank card monthly per the declared withdrawal information; during the validity of the online-signed & filed rental contract, application information may be submitted via official online channels ("SuiShenBan") or at the district management department of the municipal provident fund center; after approval, funds are paid monthly — applications accepted on or before the 15th of a month arrive on the 25th of the same month; applications accepted after the 15th arrive on the 25th of the next month; when the account balance is insufficient, withdrawal is automatically made at the balance amount (retaining CNY 0.01), and the un-withdrawn portion accumulates month by month during the business's validity and is automatically topped up on the 25th of each month; ② one-time withdrawal — where the rental contract has terminated and some months' already-paid rent has not been withdrawn, a one-time application may be made, and must be submitted at the district management department within 6 months after the contract's termination (only for actually paid rent, excluding prepaid rent). Processing time: where application materials/information are complete, the municipal provident fund center shall decide to approve or reject the withdrawal within 3 working days from acceptance and notify the applicant (time needed to verify housing ownership status, rental information, and marital information is not counted). knowledge_entries.title: Empirical: after signing a Shanghai rental contract, promptly handle online signing & record-filing and keep the filing notice
knowledge_entries.summary: Empirical advice (not policy original; title corrected: the original "before signing" contradicted the body text's "after signing" — online signing & record-filing is handled when/after the contract is signed): after signing a Shanghai rental contract, it is recommended to handle rental contract online signing & record-filing via SuiShenBan (the "我要租房" (I Want to Rent) / "不见面办理" (Contactless Processing) sections) or at offline district rental service centers / community affairs reception service centers, and keep the Housing Rental Contract Record-Filing Notice (downloadable as an electronic license in SuiShenBan). Official basis: Article 10 of the Shanghai Housing Rental Contract Online Signing and Record-Filing Operating Rules specifies that "after handling online signing and record-filing, the parties obtain the Housing Rental Contract Record-Filing Notice", and that "the parties may download the Housing Rental Contract Record-Filing Notice electronic license via the SuiShenBan mobile app"; Article 9 confirms self-closed deals may be handled online via SuiShenBan with materials exempt from submission. Whether filing is mandatory, filing time limits, etc. follow government documents (see the policy entries in this JSON); this entry is operational experience only.
knowledge_entries.applicability: Shanghai housing rental related
knowledge_entries.exclusions: Empirical, not a policy conclusion; the claim that "filing is a prerequisite for residence registration / provident fund withdrawal and a dispute voucher" is empirical inference, not document wording.
